armyRules.name: Combat Doctrines
armyRules.text:
At the start of your Command phase, you can select one combat doctrine listed below. If you do, that combat doctrine is active for friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES units with this ability until the start of your next Command phase.

ASSAULT DOCTRINE
When this unit is selected to make an advance move, that advance move does not prevent this unit from being eligible to declare a charge.

DEVASTATOR DOCTRINE
This unit’s ranged attacks have [ASSAULT].

TACTICAL DOCTRINE
When this unit is selected to make a fall-back move, that fall-back move does not prevent this unit from being eligible to shoot and eligible to declare a charge.
Unless otherwise stated:

- You can only select each combat doctrine once per battle.

- Only one combat doctrine can be active for each unit. If a rule makes a combat doctrine active for a unit, any combat doctrine previously active for that unit is no longer active for that unit.

armyRules.name: Transhuman Strategist
armyRules.text: At the start of the battle round, if a model with this ability is your WARLORD, gain 1CP.

armyRules.name: Librarius
armyRules.text:
ADEPTUS ASTARTES PSYKER units with this ability have a psyker level of 1 or higher, specified in that unit’s abilities. Each psychic ability has a psychic level of 1 or higher, specified in that ability’s name.

In a battle round, a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES PSYKER unit can use a number of psychic abilities whose total psychic level does not exceed that PSYKER unit’s psyker level.

Example: In a battle round, a psyker level 3 PSYKER unit could use three psychic level 1 abilities, or one psychic level 1 ability and one psychic level 2 ability, or one psychic level 3 ability.

armyRules.name: Space Marine Chapters
armyRules.text:
If an ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit has a second Faction keyword on its datasheet, that Faction keyword is the name of that unit’s Chapter. For example, Marneus Calgar has both the ADEPTUS ASTARTES and ULTRAMARINES Faction keywords,and is therefore from the Ultramarines Chapter.

You cannot include units from more than one Chapter in your army.

armyRules.name: Special Move Types
armyRules.text:
The following are special move types that certain or all of your units are eligible to make.

SHOCK DISEMBARK MOVE18.07

SET-UP DISTANCE: 3"

ELIGIBLE IF:

- Embarked within a TRANSPORT on the battlefield

- Did not embark within that TRANSPORT this phase

EFFECT: Set up as described in Set Up (03.02).

WHILE MOVING: Set up each model wholly within the set-up distance of that TRANSPORT.

AFTER MOVING: Your unit is not eligible to declare a charge until the end of the turn.

ASSAULT DISEMBARK MOVE18.06

SET-UP DISTANCE: 3"

ELIGIBLE IF:

- Embarked within a TRANSPORT on the battlefield

- Did not embark within that TRANSPORT this phase

- That TRANSPORT has not made an advance/fall-back move this phase

EFFECT: Set up as described in Set Up (03.02).

WHILE MOVING: Set up each model wholly within the set-up distance of that TRANSPORT.

armyRules.text:
While this unit is within 6" of a friendly SPACE WOLVES CHARACTER model (excluding WULFEN models) or within 12" of a friendly WOLF PRIEST model, if this unit is not battle-shocked:

- If this unit has VEHICLE, this unit has +3 OC.

Bestial Forms: For the purposes of transport capacity, each WULFEN model takes up the space of 2 models.

rule.name: Purge and Sanctify
rule.text:
Each time a friendly CRUSADER SQUAD unit makes a surge move, instead of selecting a surge target, you can select the closest objective to that unit. When that unit makes that surge move, each model in that unit must end that surge move as close as possible to that objective instead.

Restrictions: Your army can include BLACK TEMPLARS units, but it cannot include any ADEPTUS ASTARTES units drawn from any other Chapter.

Doctrinal Flexibility.name: DOCTRINAL FLEXIBILITY
Doctrinal Flexibility.effect: Select one combat doctrine. That combat doctrine is active for your unit until the start of your next Command phase.
Doctrinal Flexibility.text:
WHEN: Your Command phase.

TARGET: One friendly CRUSADER SQUAD unit.

EFFECT: Select one combat doctrine. That combat doctrine is active for your unit until the start of your next Command phase.
Doctrinal Flexibility.flavour: For all their zealous fury, the Black Templars are Space Marines still, capable of adapting their strategies in the midst of battle to ensure the foe’s destruction.

Angels Defiant.effect: Attacks that target your unit with a S greater than your unit’s T have -1 to wound rolls.

Restrictions: Your army can include BLACK TEMPLARS units, but it cannot include any ADEPTUS ASTARTES units drawn from any other Chapter.

Unsparing Execution.effect: When an enemy unit engaged with your unit is selected to make a fall-back move , that enemy unit must use the desperate escape mode, with -1 to those hazard rolls if that enemy unit is battle-shocked.

WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when a unit is selected to make a fall-back move, if that unit is engaged with a friendly SWORD BRETHREN SQUAD unit.

rule.name: Templar Vows
rule.text:
At the start of the first battle round, you can select one Vow listed below. That Vow is active for friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES units until the end of the battle.

Abhor the Witch, Destroy the Witch
This unit’s melee attacks that target a PSYKER unit:

- Have [PRECISION].

- Have [LANCE].

Accept Any Challenge, No Matter the Odds
Friendly melee attacks that target a unit with a T greater than this unit’s S have +1 to wound rolls.

Uphold the Honour of the Emperor
Friendly INFANTRY units have:

- At the end of your Movement phase, if this unit is controlling an objective, that objective is secured.

- When this unit is selected to make an advance move, that advance move does not prevent this unit from being eligible to start an action.

Restrictions: Your army can include BLACK TEMPLARS units, but it cannot include any ADEPTUS ASTARTES units drawn from any other Chapter.

Dread Crusaders.when: Your opponent’s Charge phase, when an enemy unit selects charge targets.
Dread Crusaders.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit that was selected as a charge target by that enemy unit this phase.

Dread Crusaders.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Charge phase, when an enemy unit selects charge targets.

TARGET: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit that was selected as a charge target by that enemy unit this phase.

For the Emperor's Honour!.name: FOR THE EMPEROR'S HONOUR!

For the Emperor's Honour!.text:
WHEN: The Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit is selected to fight.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s melee attacks have [PRECISION].
For the Emperor's Honour!.flavour: Filled with the spirit of Sigismund, his heirs seek out the foe’s dark and unclean champions so that they may be crushed in the sight of their thralls.

Heresy Begets Retribution.name: HERESY BEGETS RETRIBUTION
Heresy Begets Retribution.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit.
Heresy Begets Retribution.effect: Your unit can make a surge move of up to D6".
Heresy Begets Retribution.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit.

Heresy Begets Retribution.flavour: Where enemies dare threaten the warriors of the God-Emperor or seek to escape their deserved death, there must be swift retribution.

Spoor of the Unholy.effect:
Your unit can ignore modifiers to your unit’s:

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Your unit can ignore modifiers to your unit’s:

- Hit rolls.
Spoor of the Unholy.flavour: Perhaps guided by visions from the Emperor, Black Templars can pick out heresy wherever it lurks.

Pious Enmity.name: PIOUS ENMITY
Pious Enmity.when: Fight phase, when a friendly CHAPLAIN/JUDICIAR unit is selected to fight.
Pious Enmity.effect:
- Your unit’s melee attacks can re-roll hit rolls of 1.

- Or: Your unit’s melee attacks that target a MONSTER/VEHICLE unit can re-roll hit rolls of 1 and wound rolls of 1.

WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly CHAPLAIN/JUDICIAR unit is selected to fight.

TARGET: That CHAPLIN/JUDICIAR unit.

EFFECT:

- Your unit’s melee attacks can re-roll hit rolls of 1.

- Or: Your unit’s melee attacks that target a MONSTER/VEHICLE unit can re-roll hit rolls of 1 and wound rolls of 1.
Pious Enmity.flavour: The warrior priests of a crusade drive Sigismund’s heirs into the heart of battle, daring the greatest abominations to face their spiritual strength.

Devout Push.name: DEVOUT PUSH
Devout Push.when: Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit is selected to make a pile-in/consolidation move.
Devout Push.effect: When making that pile-in/consolidation move, your unit can move up to D3+3".
Devout Push.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit is selected to make a pile-in/consolidation move.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit.

EFFECT: When making that pile-in/consolidation move, your unit can move up to D3+3".
Devout Push.flavour: With a zealous cry, the Black Templars press forward, using their ceramite-armoured bulk to smash into the foe and overwhelm the enemy’s lines.

rule.name: Combat Doctrines
rule.text:
At the start of your Command phase, you can select one of the Combat Doctrines listed below. Until the start of your next Command phase, that Combat Doctrine is active and its effects apply to all ^^**Adeptus Astartes**^^ units from your army. You can only select each Combat Doctrine once per battle.


DEVASTATOR DOCTRINE 
This unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Advanced.


TACTICAL DOCTRINE
This unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.


ASSAULT DOCTRINE
This unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.

Armour of Contempt.name: ARMOUR OF CONTEMPT
Armour of Contempt.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.
Armour of Contempt.effect: Attacks that target your unit have -1 AP until that enemy unit has attacked.
Armour of Contempt.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Attacks that target your unit have -1 AP until that enemy unit has attacked.
Armour of Contempt.flavour: The belligerence of the Adeptus Astartes combined with their post-human physiology makes them unyielding foes to face.

A Worthy Death.name: A WORTHY DEATH
A Worthy Death.when: Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.
A Worthy Death.effect:
When a model in your unit is destroyed, if your unit has not been selected to fight this phase, roll one D6:

- On a 4+, do not remove that model from the battlefield. When your unit has fought, or at the end of the phase (whichever comes first), that model is removed from the battlefield.
A Worthy Death.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: When a model in your unit is destroyed, if your unit has not been selected to fight this phase, roll one D6:

- On a 4+, do not remove that model from the battlefield. When your unit has fought, or at the end of the phase (whichever comes first), that model is removed from the battlefield.
A Worthy Death.flavour: Those Space Marines who specialise in close assault are ready to fight to their last breath and beyond to cut down more foes.

Might of Angels.name: MIGHT OF ANGELS
Might of Angels.when: Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to fight.
Might of Angels.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to fight.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s melee attacks have [Lance].
Might of Angels.flavour: Relentless assault training allows these warriors to focus their already impressive might into a truly devastating close-quarters onslaught.

Adaptive Strategy.name: ADAPTIVE STRATEGY
Adaptive Strategy.effect: Select one combat doctrine. That combat doctrine is active for your unit until the start of your next Command phase.
Adaptive Strategy.text:
WHEN: Your Command phase.

TARGET: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Select one combat doctrine. That combat doctrine is active for your unit until the start of your next Command phase.
Adaptive Strategy.flavour: The tenets of the Codex Astartes allow for unorthodox use of combat tactics and the employment of divergent doctrines if doing so will lead to victory.

Storm of Devastation.name: STORM OF DEVASTATION
Storm of Devastation.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to shoot.
Storm of Devastation.effect: Your unit’s ranged attacks have [IGNORES COVER].
Storm of Devastation.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to shoot.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged attacks have [IGNORES COVER].
Storm of Devastation.flavour: Masters of the art of long-ranged warfare, these warriors unleash utter devastation upon their enemies.

Responsive Tactics.name: RESPONSIVE TACTICS
Responsive Tactics.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly unengaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY/MOUNTED unit.
Responsive Tactics.effect: Your unit can make a normal move of up to D6".
Responsive Tactics.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly unengaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY/MOUNTED unit.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY/MOUNTED unit.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a normal move of up to D6".
Responsive Tactics.flavour: Space Marines know precisely when to give ground to leave enemies floundering, before surging back and driving them from the field in disarray.

MELEE WEAPONS

augmentedtargeting.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to attack.
augmentedtargeting.effect:
Your unit’s attacks have:

- [LETHAL HITS].

- Or: [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

- Or: If your unit is entrenched, [LETHAL HITS] and [SUSTAINED HITS 1].
augmentedtargeting.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to attack.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s attacks have:

- [LETHAL HITS].

- Or: [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

- Or: If your unit is entrenched, [LETHAL HITS] and [SUSTAINED HITS 1].
augmentedtargeting.flavour: Auto-sense targeting subroutines specially adapted for defensive fire patterns aid these warriors’ aim.

establishsupremacy.name: ESTABLISH SUPREMACY
establishsupremacy.when: Fight phase, when a friendly entrenched ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit is selected to make a consolidation move.
establishsupremacy.effect:
You can select the objective consolidation mode for that consolidation move, regardless of that consolidation move’s Before Moving restrictions.

Designer’s Note: This means your unit can move out of engagement range with enemy units, provided it meets the conditions of the objective consolidation mode.
establishsupremacy.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly entrenched ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit is selected to make a consolidation move.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit.

EFFECT: You can select the objective consolidation mode for that consolidation move, regardless of that consolidation move’s Before Moving restrictions.

Designer’s Note: This means your unit can move out of engagement range with enemy units, provided it meets the conditions of the objective consolidation mode.
establishsupremacy.flavour: Steadfast and determined, the Imperial Fists favour methodical advances, securing and consolidating positions to establish battlefield dominance before turning their attention to the elimination of remaining foes.

prioritystrike.name: PRIORITY STRIKE
prioritystrike.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY/MOUNTED unit is selected to attack.
prioritystrike.effect: Your unit’s attacks that target a MONSTER/VEHICLE unit, have +1 to wound rolls.
prioritystrike.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY/MOUNTED unit is selected to attack.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY/MOUNTED unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s attacks that target a MONSTER/VEHICLE unit, have +1 to wound rolls.
prioritystrike.flavour: Eliminating key enemy assets is crucial to stalling then reversing the foe’s momentum.

evasiverepositioning.name: EVASIVE REPOSITIONING
evasiverepositioning.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit has shot.
evasiverepositioning.target: One friendly unengaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY/MOUNTED unit that lost a wound as a result of those attacks.
evasiverepositioning.effect:
- Your unit can make a normal move of up to D6".

- Or: If your unit is entrenched, your unit can make a normal move of up to D3+3".

Your unit is not able to embark within a TRANSPORT until the end of the turn.
evasiverepositioning.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit has shot.

TARGET: One friendly unengaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY/MOUNTED unit that lost a wound as a result of those attacks.

EFFECT:

- Your unit can make a normal move of up to D6".

- Or: If your unit is entrenched, your unit can make a normal move of up to D3+3".

Your unit is not able to embark within a TRANSPORT until the end of the turn.
evasiverepositioning.flavour: Codex doctrine when conducting an aggressive defence is to swiftly take up new positions whenever the foe finds your range.

exemplaryvigilance.name: EXEMPLARY VIGILANCE
exemplaryvigilance.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to shoot.
exemplaryvigilance.effect: Your unit’s ranged attacks have [IGNORES COVER].
exemplaryvigilance.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to shoot.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged attacks have [IGNORES COVER].
exemplaryvigilance.flavour: Long have the Ultramarines guarded both Ultramar and the wider Imperium. No foe can hide from their vengeful gaze or evade the reach of their wrath.

ultramarianadaptivity.name: ULTRAMARIAN ADAPTIVITY
ultramarianadaptivity.effect: Select one combat doctrine. That combat doctrine is active for your unit until the start of your next Command phase.
ultramarianadaptivity.text:
WHEN: Your Command phase.

TARGET: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Select one combat doctrine. That combat doctrine is active for your unit until the start of your next Command phase.
ultramarianadaptivity.flavour: No Chapter’s warriors know better the breadth - theoretical and practical - of the Codex Astartes’ teachings, and how these can and should be adapted to ensure victory.

courageandhonour.name: COURAGE AND HONOUR!
courageandhonour.when: Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to fight.
courageandhonour.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to fight.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s melee attacks have [Lance].
courageandhonour.flavour: Roaring their famed battle cry, the Ultramarines hurl themselves into the fight, striving all the harder to prevail beneath the unwavering eye of their Chapter Master.

practicaltactics.name: PRACTICAL TACTICS
practicaltactics.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly unengaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY/MOUNTED unit.
practicaltactics.effect: Your unit can make a normal move of up to D3+3".
practicaltactics.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly unengaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY/MOUNTED unit.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY/MOUNTED unit.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a normal move of up to D3+3".
practicaltactics.flavour: After rapidly making a theoretical assessment of the foes’ probable next moves, the Ultramarines apply practical repositioning to counter them.

tacticalforesight.name: TACTICAL FORESIGHT
tacticalforesight.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.
tacticalforesight.effect: Attacks that target your unit with a S greater than this unit’s T have -1 to wound rolls.
tacticalforesight.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Attacks that target your unit with a S greater than this unit’s T have -1 to wound rolls.
tacticalforesight.flavour: With the enemy’s countermeasures and responses predicted and allowed for in advance, the Ultramarines can weather their most ferocious attacks.

intodarkness.name: INTO DARKNESS
intodarkness.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
intodarkness.target: One unengaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit.
intodarkness.effect: Place your unit in strategic reserves.
intodarkness.text:
WHEN: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.

TARGET: One unengaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit.

EFFECT: Place your unit in strategic reserves.
intodarkness.flavour: At the opportune moment, Raven Guard infiltration units slip away from battle, only to relocate ready to strike the foe again.

raptorialvigilance.name: RAPTORIAL VIGILANCE
raptorialvigilance.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly unengaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit.
raptorialvigilance.effect:
Your unit can make a normal move of:

- Up to D6".

- Or: If your unit is a PHOBOS/SCOUT SQUAD unit, up to 6".
raptorialvigilance.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly unengaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a normal move of:

- Up to D6".

- Or: If your unit is a PHOBOS/SCOUT SQUAD unit, up to 6".
raptorialvigilance.flavour: The Raven Guard are swift to exploit the movements of their foes, whether to pursue their prey and complete the kill or to make use of an opportunity to fade once more from sight.

murderousfusillade.name: MURDEROUS FUSILLADE
murderousfusillade.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit that made an ingress move this turn is selected to shoot.
murderousfusillade.effect:
Your unit’s ranged attacks have:

- +1 BS.

- +1 AP.
murderousfusillade.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit that made an ingress move this turn is selected to shoot.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged attacks have:

- +1 BS.

- +1 AP.
murderousfusillade.flavour: From darkness and obscuring cover, Raven Guard battle-brothers open fire as one, striking their unaware targets with precision fire.

suppressedweapons.name: SUPPRESSED WEAPONS
suppressedweapons.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit has shot.
suppressedweapons.effect: Those attacks do not prevent your unit from being hidden.
suppressedweapons.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit has shot.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit.

EFFECT: Those attacks do not prevent your unit from being hidden.
suppressedweapons.flavour: The Raven Guard commonly utilise integral suppressors, flash-hiders and other technology to dampen weapon reports and conceal muzzle flare, enabling battle-brothers to fire on unsuspecting foes without giving away their positions.

feintandthrust.name: FEINT AND THRUST
feintandthrust.target: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit.
feintandthrust.effect: The tactical doctrine is active for your unit in addition to any other combat doctrine, until the start of your next Command phase.
feintandthrust.text:
WHEN: Your Command phase.

TARGET: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit.

EFFECT: The tactical doctrine is active for your unit in addition to any other combat doctrine, until the start of your next Command phase.
feintandthrust.flavour: Retreating from the fight, these warriors lure their enemies on before swiftly turning the tables and hurling themselves into their now overextended foe.

laylowthetyrants.name: LAY LOW THE TYRANTS
laylowthetyrants.when: Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit is selected to fight.
laylowthetyrants.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit is selected to fight.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY.

EFFECT: Your unit’s melee attacks have [Precision].
laylowthetyrants.flavour: In a storm of blade thrusts and bludgeoning strikes, enemy champions and commanders are laid low, leaving their troops in leaderless disarray.

blazingearth.name: BLAZING EARTH
blazingearth.when: Start of your opponent’s Charge phase.
blazingearth.target: One friendly unengaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit equipped with one or more Torrent/Melta weapons.
blazingearth.effect: Select one visible enemy unit within 12" of your unit. That enemy unit has -1 to charge rolls.
blazingearth.text:
WHEN: Start of your opponent’s Charge phase.

TARGET: One friendly unengaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit equipped with one or more Torrent/Melta weapons.

EFFECT: Select one visible enemy unit within 12" of your unit. That enemy unit has -1 to charge rolls.
blazingearth.flavour: When faced with an onrushing horde, the Forgefather’s warriors set fire to the earth beneath their feet, impeding their advance and throwing them into confusion.

wrathandruin.name: WRATH AND RUIN
wrathandruin.target: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit.
wrathandruin.effect: The assault doctrine or tactical doctrine is active for your unit, until the start of your next Command phase.
wrathandruin.text:
WHEN: Your Command phase.

TARGET: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit.

EFFECT: The assault doctrine or tactical doctrine is active for your unit, until the start of your next Command phase.
wrathandruin.flavour: Having drawn their enemies in, Space Marine battle-brothers fall back and open fire at point-blank range before thundering forward to put any survivors to death.

forgedinfire.name: FORGED IN FIRE
forgedinfire.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly engaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to shoot.
forgedinfire.effect:
Your unit’s Torrent weapons:

- Do not have [Blast].

- Have [Close-Quarters].

- Have +1 A.
forgedinfire.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly engaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to shoot.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s Torrent weapons:

- Do not have [Blast].

- Have [Close-Quarters].

- Have +1 A.
forgedinfire.flavour: The Salamanders are masters of the flamer, wielding such weapons with supreme precision and utilising them even in the press of melee combat.

immolationprotocols.name: IMMOLATION PROTOCOLS
immolationprotocols.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit is selected to attack.
immolationprotocols.effect: Your unit’s ranged [TORRENT] attacks have +1 AP.
immolationprotocols.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit is selected to attack.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY.

EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged [TORRENT] attacks have +1 AP.
immolationprotocols.flavour: Salvo after salvo of burning promethium unleashed in synchronised waves will leave almost any foe as smouldering ash.

crucibleofbattle.name: CRUCIBLE OF BATTLE
crucibleofbattle.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit is selected to attack an enemy unit within 6".
crucibleofbattle.effect:
Your unit’s attacks can:

- Re-roll hit rolls of 1.

- Re-roll wound rolls of 1.
crucibleofbattle.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit is selected to attack an enemy unit within 6".

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s attacks can:

- Re-roll hit rolls of 1.

- Re-roll wound rolls of 1.
crucibleofbattle.flavour: Only where the enemy can be faced eye to eye can a Space Marine be truly tested.

burningvengeance.name: BURNING VENGEANCE
burningvengeance.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit has shot a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES TRANSPORT unit.
burningvengeance.target: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit embarked within that ADEPTUS ASTARTES TRANSPORT unit.
burningvengeance.effect:
Your ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit can:

- Make a disembark move.

- Shoot using normal shooting, but when doing so your unit can only target that enemy unit.
burningvengeance.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit has shot a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES TRANSPORT unit.

TARGET: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit embarked within that ADEPTUS ASTARTES TRANSPORT unit.

EFFECT: Your ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit can:

- Make a disembark move.

- Shoot using normal shooting, but when doing so your unit can only target that enemy unit.
burningvengeance.flavour: To open fire on warriors of the Salamanders is merely to invite one’s own swift destruction.

evasivemanoeuvers.name: EVASIVE MANOEUVERS
evasivemanoeuvers.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED/SPEEDER unit.
evasivemanoeuvers.effect: Ranged attacks that target your unit have -1 to wound rolls.
evasivemanoeuvers.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED/SPEEDER unit.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED/SPEEDER unit.

EFFECT: Ranged attacks that target your unit have -1 to wound rolls.
evasivemanoeuvers.flavour: Battle-brothers of the White Scars Chapter are born and raised in the saddle. Expert pilots and riders all, they weave through incoming fire with instinctive skill.

mobilelethality.name: MOBILE LETHALITY
mobilelethality.when: Your Movement phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to make an advance/fall-back move.
mobilelethality.effect:
- That fall-back move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to shoot.

- Your unit’s ranged attacks have [ASSAULT].
mobilelethality.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to make an advance/fall-back move.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT:

- That fall-back move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to shoot.

- Your unit’s ranged attacks have [ASSAULT].
mobilelethality.flavour: The White Scars fight their wars at a furious tempo, and their warriors are adept at fire-and-manoeuvre strategies.

flawlessriders.name: FLAWLESS RIDERS
flawlessriders.when: Your Movement/Charge phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED unit is selected to move or declares a charge.
flawlessriders.text:
WHEN: Your Movement/Charge phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED unit is selected to move or declares a charge.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED unit.

EFFECT: Your unit has MOBILE.
flawlessriders.flavour: Skilled Space Marine riders can guide their steeds through even the densest and most treacherous terrain to strike their foes from the position they least expect.

spearthrustandsabreswing.name: SPEAR THRUST AND SABRE SWING
spearthrustandsabreswing.when: Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to fight.
spearthrustandsabreswing.effect:
Your unit’s melee attacks:

- Have [LETHAL HITS].

- Or: Have [LANCE].

- Or: If your unit has MOUNTED, have [LETHAL HITS] and [LANCE].
spearthrustandsabreswing.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to fight.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s melee attacks:

- Have [LETHAL HITS].

- Or: Have [LANCE].

- Or: If your unit has MOUNTED, have [LETHAL HITS] and [LANCE].
spearthrustandsabreswing.flavour: Some foes can be ended with a single charge. Others require sustained savagery to fell. The White Scars are adept at both methods of fighting.

withdrawandregroup.name: WITHDRAW AND REGROUP
withdrawandregroup.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
withdrawandregroup.target: One friendly unengaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED/SPEEDER unit.
withdrawandregroup.effect: Place your unit in strategic reserves.
withdrawandregroup.text:
WHEN: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.

TARGET: One friendly unengaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED/SPEEDER unit.

EFFECT: Place your unit in strategic reserves.
withdrawandregroup.flavour: The riders and pilots sweep away as swiftly as they arrive, regrouping in preparation for their next assault.

huntersinstincts.name: HUNTER'S INSTINCTS
huntersinstincts.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly unengaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY/MOUNTED/SPEEDER unit.
huntersinstincts.effect: Your unit can make a normal move of up to D3+3".
huntersinstincts.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly unengaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY/MOUNTED/SPEEDER unit.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY/MOUNTED/SPEEDER unit.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a normal move of up to D3+3".
huntersinstincts.flavour: The White Scars read the ebb and flow of battle with the hungry cunning of raptorial predators, reacting to the enemy’s movements with exceptional rapidity.

doctrinalflexibility.name: DOCTRINAL FLEXIBILITY
doctrinalflexibility.effect: Select one combat doctrine. That combat doctrine is active for your unit until the start of your next Command phase.
doctrinalflexibility.text:
WHEN: Your Command phase.

TARGET: One friendly CRUSADER SQUAD unit.

EFFECT: Select one combat doctrine. That combat doctrine is active for your unit until the start of your next Command phase.
doctrinalflexibility.flavour: For all their zealous fury, the Black Templars are Space Marines still, capable of adapting their strategies in the midst of battle to ensure the foe’s destruction.

angelsdefiant.name: ANGELS DEFIANT
angelsdefiant.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly CRUSADER SQUAD unit.
angelsdefiant.effect: Attacks that target your unit with a S greater than your unit’s T have -1 to wound rolls.
angelsdefiant.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly CRUSADER SQUAD unit.

TARGET: That CRUSADER SQUAD unit.

EFFECT: Attacks that target your unit with a S greater than your unit’s T have -1 to wound rolls.
angelsdefiant.flavour: All too aware of their vital role in holding the foe at bay, these battle-brothers refuse to yield to even the most grievous of wounds.

avoweddestruction.name: AVOWED DESTRUCTION
avoweddestruction.when: The Fight phase, when a friendly CRUSADER SQUAD unit is selected to fight.
avoweddestruction.effect:
Your unit’s melee attacks:

- Have [LETHAL HITS].

- Or: Have [SUSTAINED HITS 1].
avoweddestruction.text:
WHEN: The Fight phase, when a friendly CRUSADER SQUAD unit is selected to fight.

TARGET: That CRUSADER SQUAD unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s melee attacks:

- Have [LETHAL HITS].

- Or: Have [SUSTAINED HITS 1].
avoweddestruction.flavour: The Black Templars will see their oaths upheld at any cost. Any foe with the temerity to impede them in this goal must be put mercilessly to the sword.

slayersofabominations.name: SLAYERS OF ABOMINATIONS
slayersofabominations.when: Fight phase, when a friendly SWORD BRETHREN SQUAD unit is selected to fight.
slayersofabominations.effect: Your unit’s melee attacks that target a MONSTER/VEHICLE unit have +2 S.
slayersofabominations.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly SWORD BRETHREN SQUAD unit is selected to fight.

TARGET: That SWORD BRETHREN SQUAD unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s melee attacks that target a MONSTER/VEHICLE unit have +2 S.
slayersofabominations.flavour: The largest manifestations of the foe's sin are branded unholy abominations, challenges which a crusade's champions gladly meet to drive their sanctified weapons deeply beneath their hides.

unsparingexecution.name: UNSPARING EXECUTION
unsparingexecution.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when a unit is selected to make a fall-back move, if that unit is engaged with a friendly SWORD BRETHREN SQUAD unit.
unsparingexecution.effect: When an enemy unit engaged with your unit is selected to make a fall-back move , that enemy unit must use the desperate escape mode, with -1 to those hazard rolls if that enemy unit is battle-shocked.
unsparingexecution.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when a unit is selected to make a fall-back move, if that unit is engaged with a friendly SWORD BRETHREN SQUAD unit.

TARGET: That SWORD BRETHREN SQUAD unit.

EFFECT: When an enemy unit engaged with your unit is selected to make a fall-back move , that enemy unit must use the desperate escape mode, with -1 to those hazard rolls if that enemy unit is battle-shocked.
unsparingexecution.flavour: Those who attempt to flee their rightful death only stroke their executioners' hatred all the hotter. None can be spared the God-Emperor's wrath.

bladeofdetestation.name: BLADE OF DETESTATION
bladeofdetestation.when: Your Charge phase, when a friendly SWORD BRETHREN SQUAD unit ends a charge move.
bladeofdetestation.effect:
Select one enemy unit engaged with your unit. Roll one D6 for each model in your unit engaged with that enemy unit:

- For each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound (to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds).
bladeofdetestation.text:
WHEN: Your Charge phase, when a friendly SWORD BRETHREN SQUAD unit ends a charge move.

TARGET: That SWORD BRETHREN SQUAD.

EFFECT: Select one enemy unit engaged with your unit. Roll one D6 for each model in your unit engaged with that enemy unit:

- For each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound (to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds).
bladeofdetestation.flavour: With roared litanies and incendiary hatred, the Sword Brethren plunge into their foe like a white-hot blade, their armoured momentum cracking armour, crushing bones, and trampling the foe underfoot.

dreadcrusaders.name: DREAD CRUSADERS
dreadcrusaders.when: Your opponent’s Charge phase, when an enemy unit selects charge targets.
dreadcrusaders.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit that was selected as a charge target by that enemy unit this phase.
dreadcrusaders.effect: That enemy unit must make a battle-shock roll, with -1 to that battle-shock roll.
dreadcrusaders.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Charge phase, when an enemy unit selects charge targets.

TARGET: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit that was selected as a charge target by that enemy unit this phase.

EFFECT: That enemy unit must make a battle-shock roll, with -1 to that battle-shock roll.
dreadcrusaders.flavour: To face the Emperor’s transhuman crusaders as they chant their litanies of detestation can chill the soul.

fortheemperorshonour.name: FOR THE EMPEROR'S HONOUR!
fortheemperorshonour.when: The Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit is selected to fight.
fortheemperorshonour.text:
WHEN: The Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit is selected to fight.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s melee attacks have [PRECISION].
fortheemperorshonour.flavour: Filled with the spirit of Sigismund, his heirs seek out the foe’s dark and unclean champions so that they may be crushed in the sight of their thralls.

heresybegetsretribution.name: HERESY BEGETS RETRIBUTION
heresybegetsretribution.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit.
heresybegetsretribution.effect: Your unit can make a surge move of up to D6".
heresybegetsretribution.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a surge move of up to D6".
heresybegetsretribution.flavour: Where enemies dare threaten the warriors of the God-Emperor or seek to escape their deserved death, there must be swift retribution.

spooroftheunholy.name: SPOOR OF THE UNHOLY
spooroftheunholy.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to attack.
spooroftheunholy.effect:
Your unit can ignore modifiers to your unit’s:

- BS and WS.

- Hit rolls.
spooroftheunholy.text:

hellfirerounds.name: HELLFIRE ROUNDS
hellfirerounds.when: Your Shooting phase when a KILL TEAM unit is selected to shoot.
hellfirerounds.effect: Your unit’s ranged attacks (excluding [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] attacks) have [ANTI-non-VEHICLE 4+].
hellfirerounds.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase when a KILL TEAM unit is selected to shoot.

TARGET: That KILL TEAM unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged attacks (excluding [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] attacks) have [ANTI-non-VEHICLE 4+].
hellfirerounds.flavour: Hellfire rounds douse their targets in voracious acids that are utterly lethal to organic life.

dragonfirerounds.name: DRAGONFIRE ROUNDS
dragonfirerounds.when: Your Shooting phase when a KILL TEAM unit is selected to shoot.
dragonfirerounds.effect:
Your unit’s ranged attacks:

- Can re-roll wound rolls of 1.

- Have [IGNORES COVER].
dragonfirerounds.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase when a KILL TEAM unit is selected to shoot.

TARGET: That KILL TEAM unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged attacks:

- Can re-roll wound rolls of 1.

- Have [IGNORES COVER].
dragonfirerounds.flavour: Dragonfire rounds are designed to explode just before contact, saturating foes in cover with searing gas and flames.

adaptivetactics.name: ADAPTIVE TACTICS
adaptivetactics.effect: Select one combat doctrine. That combat doctrine is active for your unit until the start of your next Command phase.
adaptivetactics.text:
WHEN: Your Command phase.

TARGET: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Select one combat doctrine. That combat doctrine is active for your unit until the start of your next Command phase.
adaptivetactics.flavour: Only a truly versatile approach to warfare allows the tactical genius of the Deathwatch to best the myriad xenos foes they face.

sitetositeteleportation.name: SITE-TO-SITE TELEPORTATION
sitetositeteleportation.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
sitetositeteleportation.target: One friendly unengaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit.
sitetositeteleportation.effect:
- Place your unit in strategic reserves.

- If your unit has KILL TEAM, your unit has Deep Strike until the end of your next Movement phase.
sitetositeteleportation.text:
WHEN: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.

TARGET: One friendly unengaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit.

EFFECT:

- Place your unit in strategic reserves.

- If your unit has KILL TEAM, your unit has Deep Strike until the end of your next Movement phase.
sitetositeteleportation.flavour: Site-to-site battlefield teleportation is a rare capability indeed, used only by the Deathwatch in extreme situations.

blackstarextraction.name: BLACKSTAR EXTRACTION
blackstarextraction.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
blackstarextraction.target: One friendly unengaged KILL TEAM unit.
blackstarextraction.effect: Place your unit in strategic reserves.
blackstarextraction.text:
WHEN: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.

TARGET: One friendly unengaged KILL TEAM unit.

EFFECT: Place your unit in strategic reserves.
blackstarextraction.flavour: Swooping low with transport bays yawning wide, Corvus Blackstar gunships extract Deathwatch warriors from the battlefield and convey them to locations where their lethal talents are most required.

intheemperorsname.name: IN THE EMPEROR’S NAME
intheemperorsname.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
intheemperorsname.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES BATTLELINE unit from your army that is within range of an objective marker and was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
intheemperorsname.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability.
intheemperorsname.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES BATTLELINE unit from your army that is within range of an objective marker and was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability.
intheemperorsname.flavour: Space Marines will suffer any hardship and endure the savagery of the most monstrous foes to see their duty done.

ceramitebulwark.name: CERAMITE BULWARK
ceramitebulwark.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES BATTLELINE unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
ceramitebulwark.effect: Select any number of models in your unit. Until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Attacks and Strength characteristics of melee weapons equipped by the selected models and each time you select targets for attacks made by those models, they must target an enemy unit that is wholly on the opposite side of a Hatchway from them.
ceramitebulwark.text:
WHEN: Fight phase.

TARGET: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES BATTLELINE unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.

EFFECT: Select any number of models in your unit. Until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Attacks and Strength characteristics of melee weapons equipped by the selected models and each time you select targets for attacks made by those models, they must target an enemy unit that is wholly on the opposite side of a Hatchway from them.
ceramitebulwark.flavour: The Space Marines present a wall of ceramite and plasteel shoulder guards to the breach as they force passage through.

dutyanddefiance.name: DUTY AND DEFIANCE
dutyanddefiance.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
dutyanddefiance.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
dutyanddefiance.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6, adding 1 to the result if your unit has the BATTLELINE keyword: on a 4+, do not remove the destroyed model from play; it can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.
dutyanddefiance.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6, adding 1 to the result if your unit has the BATTLELINE keyword: on a 4+, do not remove the destroyed model from play; it can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.
dutyanddefiance.flavour: Even when wounded unto death, still the Adeptus Astartes fight on in hopes their final efforts will spell the difference between defeat and victory.

voxamplifiedroar.name: VOX-AMPLIFIED ROAR
voxamplifiedroar.when: Your Charge phase, just after an ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army declares a charge.
voxamplifiedroar.effect: Each target of that charge must take a Battle-shock test.
voxamplifiedroar.text:
WHEN: Your Charge phase, just after an ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army declares a charge.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Each target of that charge must take a Battle-shock test.
voxamplifiedroar.flavour: In the echoing confines of a voidship, the deafening battle cries of the Space Marines evoke terror in the foe.

knifework.name: KNIFE WORK
knifework.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
knifework.effect: Until the end of the phase, improve the Strength and Armour Penetration characteristics of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit by 1.
knifework.text:
WHEN: Fight phase.

TARGET: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, improve the Strength and Armour Penetration characteristics of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit by 1.
knifework.flavour: These warriors strike at their enemies'weak spots, aiming to silence the foe without raising the alarm.

enhancedefficiency.name: ENHANCED EFFICIENCY
enhancedefficiency.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
enhancedefficiency.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit is selected to make a Normal or Advance move, it can attempt to operate one Hatchway it is within 1” of either at the start or end of that move. If it does, it cannot attempt to operate a Hatchway again this turn.
enhancedefficiency.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase.

TARGET: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit is selected to make a Normal or Advance move, it can attempt to operate one Hatchway it is within 1” of either at the start or end of that move. If it does, it cannot attempt to operate a Hatchway again this turn.
enhancedefficiency.flavour: Moving with alacrity, clearing each new space with exceptional speed and skill, the warriors of the strike team advance on their main objective.

fightingretreat.name: FIGHTING RETREAT
fightingretreat.when: Your Movement phase, just after an ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army is selected to Fall Back.
fightingretreat.effect: Select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of your unit and roll one D6: on a 2-4, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound; on a 5+, that enemy unit suffers 2 mortal wounds.
fightingretreat.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, just after an ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army is selected to Fall Back.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of your unit and roll one D6: on a 2-4, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound; on a 5+, that enemy unit suffers 2 mortal wounds.
fightingretreat.flavour: These warriors employ cover fire and frag charges to batter the foe as they fall back to new positions.

mastermarksmen.name: MASTER MARKSMEN
mastermarksmen.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
mastermarksmen.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] ability.
mastermarksmen.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] ability.
mastermarksmen.flavour: Every shot these warriors fire is placed for maximum impact and swift, decisive kills.

towerofstrength.name: TOWER OF STRENGTH
towerofstrength.when: Start or end of any phase.
towerofstrength.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES TERMINATOR unit from your army.
towerofstrength.effect: Until the end of your next Command phase, add 1 to the Objective Control characteristic of models in your unit.
towerofstrength.restrictions: Each time you use this Stratagem, you cannot use it again until after your next Command phase.
towerofstrength.text:
WHEN: Start or end of any phase.

TARGET: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES TERMINATOR unit from your army.

EFFECT: Until the end of your next Command phase, add 1 to the Objective Control characteristic of models in your unit.

RESTRICTIONS: Each time you use this Stratagem, you cannot use it again until after your next Command phase.
towerofstrength.flavour: Each individual Terminator is a walking fortress. When they stand together they are truly indomitable.

focusingshrine.name: FOCUSING SHRINE
focusingshrine.when: Your Movement phase, at the start of the Reinforcements step.
focusingshrine.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES TERMINATOR unit from your army that is in Reserves.
focusingshrine.effect: Until the end of the phase, when setting up your unit on the battlefield using its Deep Strike ability, you can set it up unit anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy models (measure this distance as you would normally for the Deep Strike ability, ignoring Walls and closed Hatchways).
focusingshrine.restrictions: Until the end of the turn, your unit is not eligible to declare a charge.
focusingshrine.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, at the start of the Reinforcements step.

TARGET: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES TERMINATOR unit from your army that is in Reserves.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, when setting up your unit on the battlefield using its Deep Strike ability, you can set it up unit anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy models (measure this distance as you would normally for the Deep Strike ability, ignoring Walls and closed Hatchways).

RESTRICTIONS: Until the end of the turn, your unit is not eligible to declare a charge.
focusingshrine.flavour: An ancient device built into the structure of the teleportarium, this relic allows for incredibly accurate teleport assaults.

carveapath.name: CARVE A PATH
carveapath.when: Your Movement phase or your Charge phase.
carveapath.target: One TERMINATOR ASSAULT SQUAD unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase and has not declared a charge this phase.
carveapath.effect: Until the end of the phase, when making a Normal, Advance or Charge move, your unit can move through a single closed Hatchway as if it was open. When doing so, that Hatchway is opened and cannot be closed for the rest of the battle. This can allow that unit to declare a charge against enemy units that are not visible to it, but to do so those enemy units must be within 1" of that Hatchway and wholly on the opposite side of it from your unit.
carveapath.restrictions: You cannot use this Stratagem more than once per turn.
carveapath.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase or your Charge phase.

TARGET: One TERMINATOR ASSAULT SQUAD unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase and has not declared a charge this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, when making a Normal, Advance or Charge move, your unit can move through a single closed Hatchway as if it was open. When doing so, that Hatchway is opened and cannot be closed for the rest of the battle. This can allow that unit to declare a charge against enemy units that are not visible to it, but to do so those enemy units must be within 1" of that Hatchway and wholly on the opposite side of it from your unit.

RESTRICTIONS: You cannot use this Stratagem more than once per turn.
carveapath.flavour: Power fists, chainfists, and sheer servo-actuated armoured mass ensure that Terminators’ paths are never barred for long.

cleansingsweep.name: CLEANSING SWEEP
cleansingsweep.when: Your opponent's Movement or Charge phase.
cleansingsweep.target: One TERMINATOR SQUAD unit from your army that has not fired Overwatch this phase.
cleansingsweep.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack while firing Overwatch, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ is required to score a hit, instead of an unmodified 6.
cleansingsweep.text:
WHEN: Your opponent's Movement or Charge phase.

TARGET: One TERMINATOR SQUAD unit from your army that has not fired Overwatch this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack while firing Overwatch, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ is required to score a hit, instead of an unmodified 6.
cleansingsweep.flavour: Refined during the clearance of infested space hulks, these methodical tactics ensure no angle of approach goes undefended.

codexwarfare.name: CODEX WARFARE
codexwarfare.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army.
codexwarfare.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced or Fell Back.
codexwarfare.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase.

TARGET: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army.

EFFECT: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced or Fell Back.
codexwarfare.flavour: The Codex Astartes is held as a hallowed work of martial genius by the Shield Chapters. Its tenets prescribe tactical adaptability and fighting on the move, advancing from one adversary to the next in a series of deadly redeployments.

overchargedbreach.name: OVERCHARGED BREACH
overchargedbreach.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
overchargedbreach.effect: Select one closed Hatchway within 9" of and visible to your unit. Open that Hatchway and, until the end of the battle, that Hatchway cannot be closed.
overchargedbreach.restrictions: You cannot use this Stratagem more than once.
overchargedbreach.text:
WHEN: Start of your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.

EFFECT: Select one closed Hatchway within 9" of and visible to your unit. Open that Hatchway and, until the end of the battle, that Hatchway cannot be closed.

RESTRICTIONS: You cannot use this Stratagem more than once.
overchargedbreach.flavour: With a well-placed volley of high-powered ammunition or a dedicated melta charge, specially equipped Space Marines can effect a permanent access route.

adaptivepurge.name: ADAPTIVE PURGE
adaptivepurge.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
adaptivepurge.effect: Select one of the following abilities: [LETHAL HITS], [IGNORES COVER] or [SUSTAINED HITS 1]. Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have that ability.
adaptivepurge.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.

EFFECT: Select one of the following abilities: [LETHAL HITS], [IGNORES COVER] or [SUSTAINED HITS 1]. Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have that ability.
adaptivepurge.flavour: Whatever hidden horrors lurk in the vessels the Shield Chapters must conquer, the warriors are able to adapt their firing tactics to ensure their destruction.

rapidtakeover.name: RAPID TAKEOVER
rapidtakeover.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit Falls Back.
rapidtakeover.target: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that was within Engagement Range of that enemy unit at the start of the phase.
rapidtakeover.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D3+1".
rapidtakeover.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit Falls Back.

TARGET: One ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit from your army that was within Engagement Range of that enemy unit at the start of the phase.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D3+1".
rapidtakeover.flavour: With one foe reeling in disarray, the battle-brothers instantly refocus on their next target, their rapid yet methodical progress capitalising on the enemy's every move.
